title: Reforging the Beskar Spear
description: The Armorer demands to examine the Darksaber and tells of its legend. The Mandalorian's possession of it has raised the interest of Paz Vizsla as well. The Armorer reveals her tools as she asks about Mando's beskar spear. She speaks of its threat, and Din agrees to have it re-forged into armor. She heats the steel and they delve deeper into Mandalorian lore, specifically of Bo-Katan Kryze and the tragedy of her history. When given the choice of what to forge from the spear, Din chooses to create a small gift for Grogu.
